exam_scheme.note: Madras School of Economics (MSE), Chennai, offers premier two-year Master of Science (M.Sc.) programmes in Actuarial Economics, Applied Quantitative Finance, Environmental Economics, Financial Economics, and General Economics. Admissions are conducted through two official channels: 50% of seats are admitted through the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduates (CUET-PG) administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA) under Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN) / MSE allocation (Paper Code COQP10 - Economics), and 50% through MSE direct admissions based on CUET-PG scores. The test comprises 75 domain-specific multiple choice questions (300 marks) in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode of 105 minutes duration. Marking scheme: +4 for correct answer, -1 for incorrect answer, 0 for unattempted questions.
